responsibility: Declares the clone_info annotation attached to cgraph nodes for virtual clone materialization. It stores IPA-CP replacement maps and IPA-SRA parameter adjustments, and provides the small API to get, create, remove, and release clone metadata held in the symbol table summaries. This header carries clone-annotation state, not the actual clone creation or body-copying algorithms.
same_name_distinction: Defines the clone_info annotation fields and inline access/removal/release API for virtual-clone metadata, whereas symtab-clones.cc only provides the summary-creation helper get_create.
